question: What exact standard NIF reference chain binds a scene node and NiTriShape to its material and texture source, and what minimum block and field set must a wholly synthetic positive model fixture contain?

dependencies.use: Accepts RVA-F-0120's retained match-group storage contract.
Accepts RVA-F-0121's counted normal-record domain and selector relationship.
Accepts RVA-F-0122's normal-vector and normal-sharing-group semantics.
Accepts RVA-F-0123's vertex-position, packed-triangle selector, and static untextured triangle-geometry decoding contract.

schemaEvidence.boundary: The pinned schema supplies field order, conditions, reference directions, and string-index representation only. No NifTools code, generated object model, dependency, or external semantic claim is incorporated.

observationSet.method: A bounded read-only in-memory walk validated every selected FPK range and NIF container, started at validated footer roots, traversed only exact NiNode child references, and resolved direct NiTriShape data and property targets by validated block index.
observationSet.privacy: The bounded walk never materialized entry names or NIF string-table contents, emitted aggregate standard-type edges only, retained no material or texture names, wrote no payload, and recorded no archive-relative name, filename, hash, byte sample, or per-file identifier.
observationSet.traversalStop: A footer root or NiNode child was followed only when its resolved exact block type was NiNode or NiTriShape. Other child types were counted only to decide the stop and were not decoded or traversed.

sceneEdges.result: Every reached NiTriShape was reached through a validated footer-root NiNode graph and referenced an exact NiTriShapeData block. No arbitrary block scan or non-NiNode scene traversal contributes to these counts.

directPropertyEdges.result: These are the exact direct property block types referenced by the inherited NiAVObject Properties lists of reached NiTriShape blocks. Only NiMaterialProperty and NiTexturingProperty payloads were decoded; every other property payload remained opaque.

materialRelationship.coverage: Every reached NiTriShape directly referenced one exact NiMaterialProperty block.
materialRelationship.stringHandling: Every non-null index was validated against its owning NIF string table. The bounded walk did not decode or retain the referenced strings.
materialRelationship.payloadBoundary: The standard NiMaterialProperty extent was consumed under the pinned layout, but ambient, diffuse, specular, emissive, glossiness, and alpha values were not interpreted or retained because no further relationship edge depends on them.
materialRelationship.promotion: The standard scene-to-material binding is the direct inherited NiAVObject property reference from NiTriShape to NiMaterialProperty. NiGeometry material-name metadata is optional and separate from that property edge.

externalSources.edge: NiSourceTexture.File Name -> validated external string index
externalSources.result: Every reached NiSourceTexture used Use External equal to one, supplied a valid non-null filename string index, and supplied a null Pixel Data reference. No filename text was decoded or retained.

embeddedSources.schemaPath: For this profile, Use External equal to zero selects a File Name metadata index and a Pixel Data reference whose schema target is NiPixelFormat, represented concretely by NiPixelData or NiPersistentSrcTextureRendererData.
embeddedSources.result: The pinned schema defines the embedded path, but the bounded observation set supplies no positive NiSourceTexture-to-pixel-data edge. Embedded texture payload structure is not promoted by this packet.

textureRelationship.promotion: The observed standard external-texture chain is NiTriShape.Properties -> NiTexturingProperty -> present TexDesc.Source -> NiSourceTexture -> validated external filename string index. NiMaterialProperty and NiTexturingProperty are sibling entries in the shape's property list; no direct material-property-to-texture edge is present.

syntheticFixtureRecipe.status: relationship recipe only; no fixture, parser, writer, or bytes were produced

required: The accepted 20.3.0.9 header, type table, block type indices, block sizes, string table, group table, and footer.
One valid footer root reference to the NiNode block.
Every reference and string index either names an existing table entry or uses the standard null value.

requiredFields.NiNode: Complete inherited NiObjectNET and NiAVObject fields, plus child and effect counts and reference arrays. Only the NiTriShape child is required by this relationship recipe.
requiredFields.NiTriShape: Complete inherited NiObjectNET and NiAVObject fields, including the property list; Data reference; nullable Skin Instance; and complete MaterialData count, name indices, extra-data values, active-material value, and update byte.
requiredFields.NiTriShapeData: The accepted scalar and conditional-array layout with present vertex-position and packed-triangle data sufficient for a nonempty triangle model. Normals and normal-sharing groups remain optional fields under their accepted presence and count contracts.
requiredFields.NiMaterialProperty: Complete inherited NiObjectNET fields and the profile-required ambient, diffuse, specular, emissive, glossiness, and alpha fields. Their chosen wholly synthetic values are fixture policy, not evidence from this packet.

optional: NiTriShape MaterialData names; 41 of 329 reached shapes used them, so the relationship does not require a retained retail name.
All property types other than NiMaterialProperty.
Skin, extra data, controllers, collision, effects, normals, and normal-sharing groups when their standard count or reference fields permit absence.
untexturedMaterialPositive.qualification: A three-block NiNode, NiTriShape, and NiTriShapeData graph is structurally possible when the inherited property count is zero, but it does not exercise the proved material relationship. The selected material-positive recipe therefore includes NiMaterialProperty.

requiredAdditionalReferences: NiSourceTexture.File Name -> a valid string-table index naming a separately supplied wholly synthetic texture resource

requiredFields.NiTexturingProperty: Complete inherited NiObjectNET fields; Texturing Flags; Texture Count; all presence bytes selected by that count; one present Base Texture TexDesc; and shader-texture count. Texture Count nine is the only value supported by this observation set.
requiredFields.TexDesc: Source reference, texturing-map flags, and Has Texture Transform. Transform fields are required only when that byte is nonzero.
requiredFields.NiSourceTexture: Complete inherited NiObjectNET fields; Use External equal to one; a valid non-null File Name index; null Pixel Data reference for the observed external path; Format Prefs; Is Static; Direct Render; and Persist Render Data.

optional: Glow and shader texture descriptors; the bounded set observed them, but the minimum external textured recipe needs only the base descriptor.
Texture-coordinate transforms when Has Texture Transform is zero.
NiTriShape MaterialData names and NiObjectNET names, which may use valid synthetic indices or the standard null value where the field contract permits.
texturedExternal.externalCompanion: The filename must identify a separately supplied wholly synthetic texture resource. This packet does not establish that resource's encoding, lookup policy, or runtime acceptance.

embeddedAlternative.reference: NiSourceTexture.Pixel Data -> embedded pixel-data block with Use External equal to zero
embeddedAlternative.status: schema-defined but not observation-supported; excluded from the minimum promoted textured recipe

boundsAndStops.referenceValidation: Every followed footer, child, data, property, texture-source, and pixel-data reference was either the standard null value or below the owning block count before its target type was resolved.
boundsAndStops.stringValidation: Every material-name, property-name, source-name, and filename index examined was either the standard null value or below the owning string count. No string bytes were decoded.
boundsAndStops.blockConsumption: Exact NiNode, NiTriShape, NiMaterialProperty, NiTexturingProperty, TexDesc, ShaderTexDesc, and NiSourceTexture layouts were bounded by their declared block extents. A mismatch would reject that NIF from the aggregate; none occurred.
boundsAndStops.unfollowed: The bounded walk did not decode unrelated property payloads, non-NiNode scene children, NiPixelData payloads, animation, skinning, transforms as semantics, coordinate conventions, winding, shader execution, or runtime resource lookup.
boundsAndStops.retail: No retail payload, filename, material name, texture name, archive-relative name, hash, or per-file identifier was written, retained, or copied.

entries.result: 261 footer roots reached 1238 exact NiNode blocks and 329 exact NiTriShape blocks; every reached shape referenced NiTriShapeData.
All 329 reached shapes directly referenced NiMaterialProperty through their inherited property lists.

275 reached shapes referenced NiTexturingProperty; 383 present descriptors referenced NiSourceTexture, and all 383 sources used validated non-null external filename indices with null pixel-data references.
No embedded NiSourceTexture or non-null pixel-data reference was observed, so the schema-defined embedded relationship remains unpromoted.

catalogPromotion.result: No guest-image catalog entity is added. The exact standard NIF relationships, aggregate observation counts, fixture recipe, and qualifications are fully represented in this manifest.

vertex-position and packed-triangle selector decoding through RVA-F-0123

studioGateImpact.activation: Model Viewer is not activated. This packet supplies a bounded relationship recipe but does not create or validate the required redistributable synthetic positive fixture.

guards: Do not infer a material-property-to-texture edge; the two property blocks are sibling references from NiTriShape.
Do not infer embedded texture support, pixel encoding, external filename contents, lookup precedence, or runtime acceptance.
Do not infer animation, skinning, transforms, coordinate conventions, winding, shader execution, visibility, or render submission.
Do not implement a parser, fixture, viewer, renderer, exporter, or writer from this packet alone.
conclusion: The standard observed scene chain is Footer root -> NiNode.Children -> NiTriShape. Each reached NiTriShape binds geometry through Data -> NiTriShapeData and binds material through its inherited Properties list -> NiMaterialProperty. Textured shapes add a sibling Properties reference -> NiTexturingProperty; each present observed TexDesc.Source resolves to NiSourceTexture, and every observed source uses a validated external filename string index with no pixel-data reference. This closes the standard external material and texture relationship path and yields four-block untextured material-positive and six-block external-textured relationship recipes. The embedded pixel-data path is schema-defined but unobserved, and no fixture or bytes were produced.
